_comment: Every vendor cap the site states, pinned to the sentence on the vendor page it was read from. scripts/check-vendor-caps.ts fetches each url at build time and fails the build when a quote is gone while the anchor (the article title) is still there. A missing quote means re-read the page, fix the number in used_by, and move the quote and checked date here. Quotes are matched case-insensitively on whitespace-collapsed text with straight apostrophes.
